note: Items a stage requires, by game item ID. Each set in 'require' is a choice: the outfit must wear one of its items, so a one-item set names that exact item, and every set must be met. 'source' says where the requirement is stated: 'wiki quest field' is the quest field of the stage's page on the Love Nikki Wiki, used wherever it names items; 'stage source note' is the stage source's note for the stage, which must still say 'quote'. 'difficulty' narrows an entry to Maiden; without it the entry holds at both. 'basis' explains a reading that is not literal. cmd/bundle fails if a stage is not in the bundle, an item is not in the catalogue, a set mixes slots other than dress, top and bottom, or two sets can never be worn together.
